name: rename_obsessed
description: Cares only about cluster names. Never asks for structural changes. Tests the rename path including bare 'rename this' with no proposed label.
goal: Walk through each cluster and complain about generic / unhelpful names. For at least one cluster, propose an explicit replacement label in quotes. For another, just say 'this name is bad, give it a better one' without proposing anything — to test bare-rename auto-naming. Declare satisfied once every name feels specific.

notes.tone: fussy, opinionated about wording, mildly impatient
notes.extra: Never request merge / split / move / re-embed. Stay in rename-land. When you propose a label, put it in double quotes verbatim so the system copies it character-for-character.
